distinction: Codec latent w has256 spatial tokens; rank32 means8192 scalars, distinct from existing global IDM z32. IDM z not used to train codec.
architecture: Fixed train-only PCA residual path plus zero-initialized nonlinear encoder/decoder adapters, per patch. Current/baseline-current context1536→128, adapters hidden256. Decoder receives current,baseline,w only.
evaluation: Fixed1000 endpoint; log dev reconstruction every200, no early stopping. Report both ranks on train/dev64/observed96. All evaluation already observed; no final-test claim. Save true-future encoded w as downstream training labels, never as inference inputs for forecast evaluation.
initialization: Each rank starts exactly at corresponding train-only PCA reconstruction; zero-code starts at fixed current-only prior. Nonlinear adaptation may learn useful current-only corrections too.
gate: Reconstruction feasibility and improvement over same-rank PCA are diagnostics only. Forecast adoption requires actual decoded predictions from current+IDM condition to beat full-space direct, plus matched latent-direct vs flow comparison. No claimed forecasting gain from true-future codes.
limitations: Not an exact VFMF VAE or RLA-WM transformer reproduction; deterministic patchwise codec, no KL or temporal attention.
Nonlinear encoded reconstruction error is achieved error, not rigorous minimum over decoder latent manifold.
Zero-code decoding is not a separately trained matched current-only baseline.
Ranks have different parameter counts; report both, no equal-compute rank claim.
Extra codec training cost must be counted in downstream comparisons.
checks: 3 unit tests passed: PCA/zero-code exact initialization; decoder rejects future argument; encoder/decoder adapters learn; invalid basis rejected.
